## Dark Spawn of Shub-Niggurath (CR 13)

**XP** 25,600  
CE Gargantuan aberration (mythos)  
**Init** +7; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 30 ft.; Perception +21  
**Aura** frightful presence (30 ft., DC 24)  


**Defense**


**AC** 30, touch 10, flat-footed 26 (+1 dodge, +3 Dex, +20 natural, –4 size)  
**hp** 189 (14d8+9126)  
**Fort** +13, **Ref** +9, **Will** +13  
**DR** 15/slashing; **Immune** acid, electricity, fire, poison  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft.  
**Melee** 4 tentacles +21 (1d8+14/19–20 plus grab)  
**Space** 20 ft.; **Reach** 20 ft.  
**Special Attacks** constrict (1d8+14), sucking maws, trample (1d8+21, DC 31)  
**Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 12th; concentration +17)  


Constant—freedom of movement  

At will—air walk, tree shape  

3/day—entangle (DC 16), command plants (DC 19)  

1/day—insanity (DC 22), tree stride  



**Statistics**


**Str** 38, **Dex** 17, **Con** 28, **Int** 16, **Wis** 19, **Cha** 21  
**Base Atk** +10; **CMB** +28 (+32 grapple); **CMD** 42 (can’t be tripped)  
**Feats** Combat Reflexes, Improved Critical (tentacles), Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes, Vital Strike, Weapon Focus (tentacles), [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Dodgility.*  
**Skills** Knowledge (arcana) +17, Knowledge (nature) +17, Knowledge (religion) +17, Perception +21, Sense Motive +18, Spellcraft +20, Stealth +8 (+16 in forests); **Racial Modifiers** +8 Stealth in forests  
**Languages** Aklo  


**Special Abilities**


**Sucking Maws (Su)** A dark spawn of Shub-Niggurath that successfully pins a creature it is grappling automatically inflicts 1d4 points of Strength drain on that creature. A DC 24 Fortitude save reduces this effect to 1 point of Strength drain. A creature drained to 0 Strength does not die but must make a DC 24 Will save at that point to resist being driven mad by the experience, as the foul green waste exuded from the same sucking mouths that drink life implant in the emptied shells strange visions and horrifying certainties. This madness manifests as schizophrenia, but with a save DC equal to the dark spawn’s Strength drain save DC listed above (DC 24 for most dark spawn). One common result of this unfortunate madness is a strange desire to return to the site of their original encounter in hopes of being consumed entirely by the creature that only drank a part of their body and mind—many of those who survive this horrific ordeal go on to found dark spawn cults of their own. The madness element of a dark spawn’s sucking maws is a mind-affecting effect. The save DC for all saving throws involved with this special ability is Constitution-based.  


**About**


**Environment** temperate forest or swamp  
**Organization** solitary, pair, or grove (3–6)  
**Treasure** standard
